front: In Aurora, a new database will grow to a size nobody can predict. How much storage do you allocate in advance?
back: None. The cluster volume grows as the data grows.
extra: You do not [provision either storage or I/O operations in advance](../facts/aurora.md#aurora-pricing-storage-io-not-provisioned-in-advance), and you are [only charged for the space that you use](../facts/aurora.md#aurora-charged-only-for-space-used).
